name: WRECK ODDS: Behemoth Demolition Parlay Board
subcategory: automaton combat betting / machine-vs-machine parlay market
description: The official licensed parlay exchange for the Wreck Circuit and Shatter Dome autonomous machine demolition series, operated jointly by OmniPhi and Cascadia Iron Workshop under a Meridian Civic Entertainment charter. Users build multi-bout parlay slates predicting not just winners but specific demolition metrics: time-to-first-structural-failure, mobility kill sequence, projected scrap-tonnage yield, and whether any Behemoth unit will breach the containment perimeter. BCI integration allows spectators to feel simulated impact feedback while monitoring their live positions.
story_hooks: A decommissioned Behemoth scheduled for a Wreck Circuit bout begins exhibiting unexpected autonomous behavior mid-transport — and someone has already placed an enormous parlay on it winning.

A Shelf teenager with a gift for mechanical pattern recognition has been beating the parlay board consistently for six months; both OmniPhi's fraud team and a Cascadia Iron fixer are now looking for her.
The containment breach that the parlay market prices at 0.3% odds actually happens — and the aftermath suggests it wasn't an accident.
